_comment: Townsfolk: the people who staff the town's buildings (a separate pool from heroes; see docs/GDD.md 'Townsfolk'). trades: building is where the trade belongs; values[level-1] is what one staffer of that level adds there (kind: relief = Fatigue shed on that building's activities, discount = percent off its chip prices, store = extra percent off at the General Store, produce = materials a week). master: what a Master in their own trade adds on top. Laborers work anywhere. traits: one per person, a separate pool from hero quirks. wages[level-1] chips a week. housing: most townsfolk a settlement holds, by tier. xp: weekly progress on the job; levels: progress needed for Hand and Master. Staff seats by building level: config staff_seats (buildings can override with staff_seats).

barkeep.name: Barkeep
barkeep.desc: Pours the drinks and listens to the talk.

parson.name: Parson
parson.desc: Keeps the chapel and the peace.

sawbones.name: Sawbones
sawbones.desc: Sets bones and mixes tonics for the doctor.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: Works the forge between the hero's visits.

drillmaster.name: Drillmaster
drillmaster.desc: An old army sergeant who runs the drills.

storekeeper.name: Storekeeper
storekeeper.desc: Knows every wholesaler from here to St. Louis.

undertaker.name: Undertaker
undertaker.desc: Digs the graves and keeps them tidy.

mucker.name: Mucker
mucker.desc: Shovels ore out of the drifts.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.desc: Runs trap lines along the creeks.

wheelwright.name: Wheelwright
wheelwright.desc: Builds wheels, mends axles, and knows how to load a wagon.

laborer.name: Laborer
laborer.desc: A strong back for any building. A Greenhorn gives half a Greenhorn's help anywhere; a Hand or Master gives a full Greenhorn's.

hard_worker.name: Hard Worker
hard_worker.desc: Works like one level higher (a Master stays a Master).

apt_pupil.name: Apt Pupil
apt_pupil.desc: Learns the job twice as fast.

handy.name: Handy
handy.desc: Gives a full Greenhorn's help in any building, trade or not.

well_liked.name: Well Liked
well_liked.desc: Everyone else working in town learns the job faster.

loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.desc: Never leaves town, paid or not.

lazybones.name: Lazybones
lazybones.desc: Works like one level lower (a Greenhorn does nothing).

grasping.name: Grasping
grasping.desc: Asks half again the usual wage.

tippler.name: Tippler
tippler.desc: One week in five, sleeps it off and doesn't show up for work.

grumbler.name: Grumbler
grumbler.desc: Everyone else working in town learns the job slower.

restless.name: Restless
restless.desc: Left idle two weeks or more, may move on (1 in 10 each week).
